response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist software engineer with strong web, backend, and systems experience, but does not meet the core mandatory requirements: his professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, there is no evidence of Windows-focused C++ development at the required 5–10 year depth, and he has no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a fintech/investment startup using Node/TypeScript, not capital-markets systems). While he has performance-oriented systems experience (DLang low-latency work) and solid CI/CD skills, the mismatch on the two hardest requirements makes him a poor fit for this role.
strengths: Strong low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and multi-language versatility
18+ years of professional software development with clear communication and teaching experience
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015), far below the 5–10 year requirement
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development background

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong systems programming and engineering practices
